tasks.business_rule: Exclude deleted customers, uppercase names, and replace NULL country with UNKNOWN; update by customer ID.
tasks.sql: SELECT `customer_id` AS CUSTOMER_ID, upper(name) AS NAME_UPPER, ifnull(country, 'UNKNOWN') AS COUNTRY FROM raw_customer WHERE deleted_flag = 0

tasks.business_rule: Replace the complete synthetic active-customer snapshot; explicit full-table overwrite decision, no partitions.
tasks.sql: SELECT CAST(customer_id AS STRING) AS CUSTOMER_ID_TEXT, upper(name) AS NAME_UPPER FROM raw_customer WHERE deleted_flag = 0
